title: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in…
description: phpMyFAQ versions 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 have an authorization bypass vulnerability in multisite deployments. This flaw allows attackers to overwrite passkeys of accounts on other tenants by exploiting a shared PHP session store. Attackers can perform a WebAuthn prepare() login on one tenant and replay the session on another tenant or the master to replace user passkeys and gain admin access.
